profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMC through Virtusa | Master’s in Information Technology and Computer Science
profile.summary: Since completing my Master's in Information Technology from the University of the Cumberlands and a previous Master's in Computer Science from Monroe College, my career has progressed to a Software Engineer role at Virtusa. Here, I apply my skills in Java development and containerization, enhanced by certifications in Java and DevOps. The culmination of my education and certifications aligns with our team's mission to innovate software systems, leveraging my expertise in programming and DevOps to contribute to impactful technology solutions.
